closures.closed_by: upstream writer add_alignment_label_group (create/alignment_labels.rs, PR #688): typed-field emission of the labels.rs record grammar — class header (constant run BL 80,0,80,80,0,0x10025F04, tag 010010, 16 residual bytes, BL 80,80,0x04BE0000,0xFFFFFF, 010), labels as keyed property sets (keys with typed values, 2 bits 00 + RC 1 + BL flag 0x1000/0x1003, the label set's key ids, overrides of the five value types the reader knows), settings (label set key 0x0F00B401/402/403, words 69,1, five doubles), range (3 bits 111 + BD start + BD end), the kind's tail (BD increment, or BL count + count x full-BL 0x0100|kind), close B 0 + BS 0x04BE; references soft 0, soft 0, alignment (soft), label style (hard), per label alignment (soft); strings the kind's class text + three empties. The 16 bytes after the tag are residual in the application's own records (zeros, UTF-16 fragments, heap addresses across the corpus) and are carried verbatim (AlignmentLabelGroup::guid). Unmapped forms (nested labels, unknown override value types, out-of-form tails/ranges) refuse — never invented
